## a) Random number generation

```{r}
A <- matrix(round(rnorm(24, mean = 0, sd = 1), digits = 1), nrow = 4, ncol = 6)
A
```

## b) Linear system solution

```{r}
A1 <- A[, -c(2, 5)]
Y = c(1:4)
X = solve(A1)%*%Y
X
```

## c) Solution validation

```{r}
A1X = A1%*%X
same = isTRUE(all.equal(as.vector(A1X), Y))
print(A1X)
print(same)
```
